content.value: A system is described by the state equation ${ \dot { x } } = A x + B u$ and output equation $y = C x$ Here, $A = { \left[ \begin{array} { l l } { - 4 } & { - 1 } \\ { 3 } & { - 1 } \end{array} \right] } , B = { \left[ \begin{array} { l } { 1 } \\ { 1 } \end{array} \right] }$ and $C = [ 1$ 0]
